description: Source code for managing WPA Supplicant configuration, including creation, loading, saving, and modification of configuration maps.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_createConfig
methods.description: Creates and initializes a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure with global and network maps.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads WPA Supplicant configuration from a file into a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes and frees a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the configuration maps into a specified file.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in the global or network configuration map.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_delConfigParam
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the configuration maps.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getGlobalConfig
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the global configuration map.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_getNetworkConfig
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the network configuration map.
